name: message-origin-unknown-kind-preserved
description: MessageOrigin.kind is a directly-typed @nonexhaustive enum (not a union discriminator), so an unrecognized value added by a newer protocol version MUST decode and re-encode verbatim rather than failing the whole message. versioning.md makes additive enum values a PATCH-compatible change, so a client built against an older version has to relay them intact. Unions already cover their own unknown-variant path (fixture 003) and open string fields cover theirs (fixture 024); this fixture covers the remaining case — an unknown value of a closed-looking enum on a plain field.
